start.speaker: Nettle
start.text: You had it beaten and it still had one left. They always have one left. That is not bad luck, that is the design.

r2.speaker: Nettle
r2.text: Four floors of that water in you. Sit down. No, sit down.

r3.speaker: Nettle
r3.text: Out clean. Rare. Drink something that is not from down there.

r4.speaker: Nettle
r4.text: The mire. Everything the vaults let go ran downhill for eleven years and arrived at my door. I know exactly what you have been standing in.

r5.speaker: Nettle
r5.text: Ten. I have buried people who stopped at two, so I will not tell you to stop.

quiet.speaker: Nettle
quiet.text: There is rot in you. There is rot in everyone who goes down. I only treat the part that is willing to be treated.
